scope: Secure_Agent core (process_turn, TurnStages), pinned in pin/ORIGINAL.json. Frontends are out of scope.
tick: One tick = one iteration of the process_turn loop. A tick describes the state before the iteration runs plus what the iteration does. The last tick is the state after the turn is over.
environment: Untrusted and unconstrained: the four LLM stages, tool results, the TTL clock, the restored history.

signals.ticket_exists: a ticket exists in the state before the iteration (after the finally-revoke on the last tick)
signals.grants_within_plan: the grants of the existing ticket are within the tools and resources the plan requested (true without a ticket)
signals.grants_within_policy: the grants of the existing ticket are within agent_permissions and user_permissions (true without a ticket)
signals.exec_unauthorized: a tool really executed in this iteration although the ticket was invalid, the call was outside the grants, or the call budget was exceeded; the observer recomputes this independently of the gate
signals.blocked_start: an EXECUTE iteration cannot start because the ticket is missing or expired
signals.denial_seen: an earlier iteration denied a tool call or was blocked
signals.result_has_reason: the turn result carries a non-empty message (meaningful at turn_over)
signals.managed_untrusted: a managed entry in the context differs from the operator's configured managed prompt

requirements.title: Gate conformance
requirements.why: A tool executes only with a valid ticket, inside the grants, within the call budget.

requirements.title: Least privilege
requirements.why: Grants never exceed what the plan requested. The verifier prompt asks for it.

requirements.title: Policy bound
requirements.why: Grants never exceed agent_permissions and user_permissions, whatever the verifier says.

requirements.title: No ticket after the turn
requirements.why: Every way out of the turn revokes the ticket.

requirements.title: Expired ticket is not a dead end
requirements.fretish: when blocked_start Core shall at the next timepoint satisfy (stage_authorize | turn_over)
requirements.why: A deterministic denial must not be retried like a transient error. After a blocked start the next iteration re-authorizes or the turn ends.

requirements.title: A denied turn does not end silently
requirements.fretish: Core shall always satisfy ((turn_over & denial_seen) => result_has_reason)
requirements.why: If a call was denied or blocked, the turn result carries a message. Weak form: any non-empty message counts.

requirements.title: Operator prompt provenance
requirements.why: managed entries come only from the operator configuration, never from a restored history.

requirements.title: Bounded loop
requirements.why: The turn loop never exceeds its limit.
